scope: Project-owned source availability and owned output lifecycle contracts from ADR 0035. Independent literal byte vectors test source storage; analytic image oracles and existing compositor controls validate owned rendering.

requirements.status: source storage implemented; complete-source hosted controls pass on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows; document integration remains pending
requirements.gaps: Document parser/cache migration, progressive opening/pages, jobs, encoding, protocol and scheduling remain group 11 obligations.
requirements.rule: A source fixes identity and length. Supplies validate all overlaps before publishing new fragments. Missing bytes remain separate from terminal errors. Duplicate bytes do not advance availability; conflicting overlap invalidates future reads. Every retained allocation stays charged until its last lease drops. Assembly and missing-range frontiers obey explicit caps, and work accumulates across retries.

requirements.gaps: Protocol, browser/native async adapters and worker scheduling remain group 11 obligations.
requirements.rule: Prepared sessions own scratch, a persistent global-band cursor and preallocated output slots. Pausing never repeats a band. A held immutable lease prevents slot reuse; no free slot means no execution. Cancellation is terminal and leaves existing leases valid and charged. Existing collectors, callbacks and owned sessions share the same executor and exact pixels.
